title: GBN-AG accompanying document types
description: The document types a notifier can attach to a GBN-AG pre-notification, used as the value space for exchangedDocument.referenceDocument[].typeCode. A static list: where a UN/CEFACT UNTDID 1001 code fits a document type, the code is copied in; the types UNTDID 1001 has no code for are given Defra codes in the GBN series. That series is allocated in sequence and never reused, so it has gaps where a type has left the list. The list does not reference any other codelist. 916 (Related document) is the code for a notifier who chooses "Other supporting documents"; it is never a default. All codes are strings. Values are listed with the UNTDID 1001 codes first in numerical order, then the Defra codes in numerical order. This file is the working source of truth in the absence of a live Defra reference-data service; when that service goes live at https://refdata.tbc.defra.gov.uk/, this file is retired and the URL stays the same.

values.label: Other veterinary certificate / veterinary declaration
values.description: UNTDID 1001 Veterinary certificate. Covers a veterinary declaration as well as a certificate, so it is broader than the UNTDID 1001 name.

values.label: ITAHC (Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate)
values.description: UNTDID 1001 Inspection certificate. TRACES sends 856 for the EU INTRA certificate ("Inspection certificate (EU Intra Certificate)"); see defra-unvtd-profile-intra-v1.schema.json.

values.label: Import permit / authorisation
values.description: UNTDID 1001 Import licence. Covers an authorisation as well as a permit, so it is broader than the UNTDID 1001 name.

values.label: Other supporting documents
values.description: UNTDID 1001 Related document. Used only when the notifier chooses "Other supporting documents".

values.label: Journey log
values.description: Defra code. UNTDID 1001 has no equivalent.

values.label: Self-declaration
values.description: Defra code. UNTDID 1001 has no equivalent.

values.label: CITES permit/certificate
values.description: Defra code. UNTDID 1001 has no equivalent.

values.label: Packing list / species list
values.description: Defra code. UNTDID 1001 has no equivalent.
